articles.title: Sensata Technologies Launches R290 Pressure + Temperature Sensor to Enable Adoption of Low-GWP and PFAS-free Refrigerants in EV Thermal Management Systems

articles.summary: Sensata’s R290 Pressure + Temperature (P+T) sensor enables automotive OEMs to adopt propane as a refrigerant in EV thermal management systems while addressing safety, leakage and regulatory challenges. Supports the transition to low-GWP and PFAS-free refrigerants with accurate, reliable pressure and temperature sensing. Offers flexible integration with Analog and LIN output options, backed by Sensata’s application expertise, validation experience and regional manufacturing capabilities. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST), today announced the launch of its R290 Pressure + Temperature (P+T) Sensor, designed to support automotive manufacturers adopting R290 (Propane) refrigerant in electrified vehicle thermal management systems. As OEMs evaluate low-GWP and PFAS-free refrigerant strategies, R290 is gaining interest for its efficiency and environmental benefits while introducing new requirements for accurate sensing, leakage control and safe system operation. articles.summary: Sensata’s new OmniNode simplifies commercial EV power distribution architecture by consolidating multiple high-voltage components into a single system. Integrates switching, protection, sensing, diagnostics, communications and charging into one modular platform. Supports scalable electrification programs through a standardized approach that helps OEMs design, validate and deploy vehicle platforms more efficiently. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST) today introduced its OmniNode, a patent-pending, off-the-shelf power distribution solution designed to help commercial vehicle manufacturers simplify high-voltage charging and vehicle architecture. The OmniNode consolidates multiple high-voltage functions into a single platform to help reduce engineering complexity, accelerate validation and support scalable electrification programs.
